title: Jagged Crunchy Ethiopian Split Peas Fritters
description: A crunchy and energizing Ethiopian dish featuring split peas, these fritters are deep-fried to perfection and offer a rich umami flavor. They are egg-free and friendly to various diets.
instructions: Rinse the split peas and soak them in water for 4 hours.
Drain and mash the split peas using a fork or a potato masher.
Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a pan over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the pan and cook for 1 minute.
In a large bowl, combine the mashed split peas, sauteed onion mixture, berbere spice, salt, and black pepper.
Mix well to form a thick batter.
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Using a spoon, drop small balls of the batter into the hot oil and fry until golden brown.
Remove the fritters from the oil and drain on paper towels.
Serve the fritters hot and enjoy.
